## LaTeX source

The `.tex` files sit beside each PDF in the [repository](https://github.com/Donniezvadah/HMTH101-Calculus-1), together with the figures. `HMTH101_Calculus_1_Full_Notes/HMTH101notes.tex` is the master document — the individual chapter files are extracts from it, and this website is generated from it.
